notes.title: Love Love Candy 1.1 update
notes.content:
1: Added a new menu to select the scenes you want to play after you have completed a level
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44128805/6857df8071baf506e194db3817f39f6498de008c.png[/img]
2: Added some eyes animation in the dressing room and gameplay
3: Added voice lines in the dressing room
4: Balanced a little the gameplay part
5: Better music\effects volumes
6: Changed the .exe name and icon
7: Fixed a big bug that some time will start the first level instead on the choosed one
8: Other minor bugs fixed

We are still working to fix and making better the game here and there with some transactions and sound effects, another update will come very soon!
